name: Temporal Smoothing for Foveated Rendering
aliases: Temporal smoothing filter for foveated rendering
definition: A temporal filter applied to peripheral vision regions to attenuate artifacts caused by low sampling density, while also providing implicit anti-aliasing and hiding sharp-to-blurry transitions during rapid eye movements.
summary: Temporal smoothing for foveated rendering averages peripheral pixels across recent frames to reduce undersampling artifacts without increasing per-frame cost, distinguishing itself by leveraging temporal coherence rather than spatial filtering.
